h1: Buying cannabis in Pattaya at a walk-in shop
intro: Labs Cannabis is a walk-in shop at 32 Pattaya 13 Alley in South Pattaya, listed on Google Maps as LABS DISPENSARY. Flower is handed over at the counter, to adults aged 20 or older who hold a prescription issued in Thailand. This page describes what buying in person actually involves; it carries no menu, no stock list and no numbers.

sections.body: Two documents are checked before anything is handed over: identification showing you are 20 or older, and a prescription issued by a licensed practitioner inside Thailand. A prescription written abroad is not accepted, and flower may not leave the country. Bring the originals rather than photographs, and expect the check to happen at the counter, not on this website.

sections.h2: How the choice is made in the shop
sections.body: Staff ask what you are after, open the jars and let you look and smell before you decide, then talk you through strain types, aromas and how the batch was grown. What sits in the jars changes with every harvest, so nothing here is a fixed catalogue. A message to WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 before you set off tells you whether it is worth crossing Pattaya today.

Since 26 June 2025 cannabis flower has been a controlled herb in Thailand. It is dispensed in person, in the shop, to adults aged 20 or older who present a prescription issued by a licensed practitioner in Thailand; such a prescription covers a course of up to 30 days. Prescriptions issued abroad are not accepted, and flower may not be taken out of the country. This paragraph states the rule and offers to arrange nothing.

faq.q: Can I reserve something in advance?
faq.a: No. There is no basket, no reservation and no payment on this site. You can ask on WhatsApp what is in the shop today, and everything else happens at the counter.
Identification that shows you are 20 or older and a prescription issued in Thailand. Both are checked at the counter before anything is handed over.

closing: Ask on WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 what is in the shop today, or open Google Maps and come to 32 Pattaya 13 Alley. Adults 20+ with a prescription issued in Thailand.
